thread:
alex_w: Heads up — Finvest just escalated. Their console trace view is showing requests but spans are missing for a subset of checkout calls. Logs have x-request-id but clicking the request in the dashboard doesn't open any trace.

maria_l: Can you paste a sample request-id and timeframe? Also any recent deploys to ingress/proxy?

alex_w: Sample: `rq_finv_20240315_8b7c` around 2024-03-15T14:22:10Z. Customer says this pattern affects ~10-15% of requests since yesterday evening. No change on their side.

ingest-bot: Ticket #CS-4821 created for Finvest escalation. Linked: https://zendesk.example/tickets/4821 :ticket:

jordan_r: @alex_w thanks. Quick checklist: 1) is the x-request-id preserved all the way into the stitcher/ingest? 2) is trace_id being emitted by runtime? 3) any sampling changes?

olivia_p: I pulled the raw ingress logs for that window. The header is present at edge for `rq_finv_20240315_8b7c` and we return 200. Example ingress line: `ingress[edge-2] - method=POST path=/checkout request_id=rq_finv_20240315_8b7c trace_id= - status=200` — note trace_id is missing in that log line.

maria_l: Interesting — runtime should always set a trace_id for instrumented requests. Could be the header got stripped/rewritten before the runtime attaches trace metadata. Any proxy changes?

alex_w: There was a deploy to the edge-router yesterday evening (PR #3456) that updated header forwarding rules. Pinged eng-infra already.

jordan_r: Oncall, can you confirm if the stitcher service (trace-stitch) saw an incoming trace for that request id? Run: `grep rq_finv_20240315_8b7c /var/log/trace-stitch/*.log` and `curl -s "$STITCH_API/lookup?request_id=rq_finv_20240315_8b7c"`

sre_oncall: Running the grep now. Quick results: trace-stitch logs show entries for request ids where `trace_id` present, but for this sample there is only an ingest record without a trace id. The `lookup` returned `{"status":"not_found"}`.

olivia_p: I also queried Kafka topic `ingest-raw`: message for rq_finv... exists but payload missing `trace_id` field. So the runtime didn't attach it or it was dropped prior to serialization.

alex_w: Customer-side headers they sent: ```
POST /checkout
Host: api.finvest.com
X-Request-ID: rq_finv_20240315_8b7c
Authorization: Bearer <token>
User-Agent: Finvest/1.2.3
```

maria_l: Two hypotheses: 1) edge-router change removed/injected headers causing runtime to skip instrumentation, or 2) a small regression in runtime sampler recently rolled that sets `trace_id` later and some fast paths write out before instrumentation. Any recent runtime rollout?

jordan_r: There was a minimal runtime patch last week (runt-2.14.1) that adjusted request path short-circuit for health-check-like paths, but nobody flagged checkout. I'll roll back candidate on a canary host.

sre_oncall: Rolling back edge-router PR #3456 on staging; will validate header passthrough. If rollback fixes, schedule hotfix for production.

olivia_p: Forensics note: when `trace_id` missing, request event still has `request_id` and body. Stitcher can't link because there's no trace anchor. Suggest immediate mitigation: enable fallback stitching by request-id for last-24h window so the dashboard links to logs even when trace missing.

maria_l: Good mitigation. @jordan_r can you add a temporary route in dashboard that queries logs by request_id when trace lookup fails? Low-risk UI change.

jordan_r: Yep — will open PR for dashboard fallback and add a feature flag. Also adding more verbose logging in runtime to capture where `trace_id` is supposed to be set.

alex_w: I'll ask Finvest for a small set of request ids and times. Also need to tell them expected ETA for a patch.

ingest-bot: CS-4821 updated: assigned to eng-infra and eng-runtime; priority=P1; SLA 24h.

olivia_p: Next steps for eng-infra: validate header forwarding config and revert if necessary. For eng-runtime: add extra asserts around `trace_id` attach point and push a patch to canary. For dashboard: implement request-id fallback link.

maria_l: If we confirm edge-router is the cause, we'll draft a customer note and offer to reprocess missing events for Finvest.

alex_w: Customer update scheduled in 2 hours. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sre_oncall: Update at +1h: staging rollback restored trace_id in staging ingress logs for sample requests. Proceeding to coordinate prod rollback tonight in the 22:00 UTC window unless eng-runtime patch lands first.

olivia_p: I'll prepare reingest plan in case we need to backfill.

alex_w: Great — keeping CS updated.
